svg.title: Information production can outgrow human inspection
svg.desc: A wide band of growing records, events, findings and model interpretations narrows through a governed decision context into the limited attention of one accountable Decision Owner.

Information production keeps growing
records · events · deterministic findings · analytical results · model interpretations

div.style: color: rgb(15, 46, 27) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;
